name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu overlay (partial)
notes: Partial: central CMVR rules plus researched state overrides (checked 2026-10-25). Verify at your RTO. Transport department: https://ddd.gov.in

text.en: In Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu the LL test can be taken online at home with Aadhaar face authentication, or at the RTO.
text.hi: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu में लर्नर लाइसेंस टेस्ट आधार फेस ऑथेंटिकेशन के साथ घर से ऑनलाइन, या RTO पर दिया जा सकता है।
